Text: Your expedition teams have discovered an experimental neuro-facility

Judging by the notes from NovaCorp scientists, the lab was working on a way to “duplicate a subject’s mind” and transplant the copy into a “cybernetically prepared host body”.

The “cybernetic preparation” wing is long gone, obliterated by a century-old meteor impact. Only a single host survives.
An ancient facility in this system contains a machine for duplicating human minds.

"These monsters thought to warp minds like a star warps steel. We say: no more."

You nod; {d(Military)} fires a spread of missiles. The facility is lost in a haze of fire.
A rough copy of {TargetCharacter}’s mind will be uploaded into a prepared host from the lab on {StarSystem}, and adopted into {House}.
“What is this place?” {he(TargetCharacter)} murmurs. When {he(TargetCharacter)} sees the chair, {he(TargetCharacter)} gasps. “This is witch-science!”
You gesture, inviting {him(TargetCharacter)} to sit. “Do you trust me?” you smile.

A helmet descends. For hours, {his(TargetCharacter)} eyes flicker as the machine reads {his(TargetCharacter)} churning mind. After an eternity, a tank hisses open deeper inside the hall. A figure stumbles out. When {he(NewCharacter)} reaches the chair and glimpses the occupant, {he(NewCharacter)} shudders. "What have we done?" “Focus,” you hiss. “Nobody can know you're a copy of {TargetCharacter}: they’d never accept it. You will claim you’re a distant cousin of {House}, far from home. What name shall we call you?” “{NewCharacter},” {he(NewCharacter)} gulps. "It was this body's name, before they wiped everything away."

{Copy} and {d_s(Original)} shuttles are circling, raking each other with gunfire. Both stop, immobilised. Their hatches open; two figures emerge, and leap toward each other.

When security arrives they are twisting in the void, both air supplies torn out: locked in a mutual deathgrip.

“Nobody understands me like you do,” {d(Copy)} chuckle{s(Copy)}.

“Which is how I know this has been hard for you,” {d(Original)} sigh{s(Original)}, clasping {d_s(Copy)} shoulder. “Seeing people from your past every day - a past you had to leave behind? I can't imagine it." {He(Original)} smile{s(Original)}. "Why don’t I re-introduce you, vouch for your character?”

{D_s(Copy)} eyes glisten. “Please.”
“Whenever I turn a corner there they are, whispering about me. How I’m 'wrong' - an inferior copy.”

"{firstName(Original)}," he sighs, "you understood me like no other."
